name: Dark Elf Magic
source: Dark Elves, Errata'd.pdf p.22 (Lustria - Cities of Gold, Dark Elf Magic)
notes: Used by the Dark Elf Sorceress, who may not cast spells while wearing armour. Original table is D6, kept as printed. Judgement calls: Doombolt's -1 Strength per jump is doubled to -2 and it stops when Strength drops to 2 or less (original: drops to one), keeping the same number of jumps; Flamesword's +2 Strength becomes +4.

spells.name: Doombolt
spells.text: Target any enemy model in line of sight within 18"; Strength 10 hit. If the target is wounded, the next closest model within 6" is also hit on a 7+ at -2 Strength than the previous hit, and so on until there are no more targets in range or Strength drops to 2 or less. Each model can only be hit once per turn. Armour saves as normal.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.text: Cast at an enemy model within 12". The victim must re-roll all successful hand-to-hand or missile attacks and all to wound rolls. To charge, he must first pass a Leadership test. Lasts until the beginning of the next Dark Elf turn.

spells.name: Soul Stealer
spells.text: The Sorceress makes a to hit roll against a model in base contact. If it hits, the target suffers a wound with no armour save possible and she gains one wound. She can never have more than one extra wound from this spell; the extra wound is lost at the end of the battle.

spells.name: Flamesword
spells.text: Choose the hand-to-hand weapon of a warband member within 6". It acts as a normal weapon of its type but adds +4 to the user's Strength. Hits from the weapon ignore armour saves. Lasts until the Sorceress' next shooting phase.

spells.name: Deathspasm
spells.text: Range 6", must be cast on the closest enemy model. The affected model must roll on the injury chart. If successfully cast, the Sorceress is immediately knocked down.

spells.name: Witch Flight
spells.text: The Sorceress may immediately move anywhere within 12" and may count as charging. If she engages a fleeing enemy in the close combat phase she scores 1 automatic hit and the opponent then flees again.
